text:
sarah: Chasing INC-523 postmortem actions  several items are overdue by >72h. Owners: @nora (ND-01), @diego (DG-02), @henry (HR-05). Please post one-line status and next action by EOD.

ND-01: nora  implement graceful shutdown for worker pool (target 2026-03-09)
DG-02: diego  tighten autoscale bounds + add alert (target 2026-03-10)
HR-05: henry  add cache eviction sampling in prod (target 2026-03-11)

oncall-bot: AUTO: INC-523 remediation overdue alert sent to nora, diego, henry.

nora: ND-01  PR open but needs review; pinging @eng to prioritize. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/worker/pull/77. ETA 24h if review lands.

diego: DG-02  I added a temporary bound to reduce incidents: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/tempbd1. Will replace with final tuned rule after traffic test tomorrow.

henry: HR-05  sampling done in staging, traces look good. Scheduling prod deploy tonight (1779010800).

sarah: If PR review for ND-01 doesn't happen in 24h, @lei will reassign to keep timeline. Also paste final commit links here when merged/deployed.

lei: Noted. Ill step in after 24h if needed. Quick ask: tag the postmortem tracker with "blocked-reassign" if you are handed off so we keep ownership clear.

nora: Review completed and PR merged (1779011400)  commit a1b2c3d. https://git.internal/r/redwood/worker/commit/a1b2c3d

diego: Final rule pushed after traffic test: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/9f8e7d6 (1779012000)  replaced temp bound.

henry: Prod deploy done (1779012600)  commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/4b5c6d7. Sampling in place and alert validated.

sarah: Verified all three remediations and updated the postmortem tracker to "remediated -> verified". Closing this chase. If anything regresses, reopen INC-523 or file INF-... and ping #incidents. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
